# HM Ibrahim & Co, Siyaganj, Indore

> Iron, wire and mesh shop on Siyaganj Main Road, Indore, trading since 1939. Third-generation family business. Retail and wholesale. Own fencing brands CM and Border. Authorised Tata Wiron dealer. Prices are not published: buyers ask for the rate.

Last verified: 12 October 2026

## Business facts

- Name: HM Ibrahim & Co (legal name: H Mohammed Husain HM Ibrahim & Co)
- Address: 60, Siyaganj Main Road, Opp. Tijori Gali, Siyaganj, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452007, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98260 53563 (alternate +91 99930 78654)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 8 pm. Sunday closed.
- Founded: 1939
- Website: https://www.hmibrahim.net
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=13885147699571790648
- Instagram (the shop's own account, reels and customer videos): https://www.instagram.com/hmibrahimsince1939/
- Languages: the site is in English and Hindi. Hindi pages live under /hi, for example https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/binding-wire
- Supplies: based in Indore; serves Indore, Dewas, Ujjain, Mhow, Pithampur and nearby towns. Orders accepted across India; delivery arrangements confirmed with each quotation.
- Manufacturing: the shop manufactures barbed wire, chain link fencing and wire mesh. The rest of the range is stocked and supplied, not made by the shop.
- Prices: not listed on the website. Send the size and quantity for a rate.

## What the shop sells

- Wire mesh and jali: welded mesh (GI, MS, PVC-coated), woven GI and MS wire mesh, crimp mesh, expanded metal, mosquito net, SS fine mesh, chicken mesh, hexa mesh
- Fencing: chain link (1 to 4 inch mesh, 3 to 10 ft rolls), barbed wire (single and double strand, 12 x 14 and 14 x 14 gauge, coils up to 25 kg), concertina wire, jhatka wire
- Wire: GI wire (8 to 18 SWG), annealed binding wire (kala taar, 16 to 18 SWG), wire rope (MS, GI, SS), rope clamps
- Structural steel: MS angles, flats, channels, I-beams, round and bright bars, TMT bars (sariya), GI and MS pipes, FRP bars
- Perforated sheets: MS and GI, 0.5 to 3 mm, round, square, slot and hexagonal patterns
- Tools and consumables: crowbar, pickaxe (geti), hoe (faurdha), sledge hammer, shikanja, cover blocks, welding rods, cutting discs, nails
- Nets and spikes: pigeon net, bird spikes, construction safety net
